issues.body:
The new rule reads: "Model-qualified header markers such as `[OPUS-5]`, `[FABLE-5]`, and `[HAIKU-…]` are legacy and migrate when touched."

Read as "when the FILE is touched", this PR is already non-compliant with the rule it lands: it touches scripts/policy-resolve.py but leaves `[OPUS-5]` at lines 43, 63 and 120 and `[FABLE-5]` at 116, and touches policy/repos.toml while leaving `[FABLE-5]` at 14 and 21. Read as "when that HEADER is rewritten" — which is what the prior round's fix hint intended and what the diff actually does — the PR is compliant and the residual markers are a documented backlog.

Across 48 files carrying ~189 of these markers, the two readings differ by a lot of incidental churn on unrelated diffs, and a future reviewer citing this line has no text to settle which one they are enforcing. Comments only; nothing parses them; not blocking.
issues.fix_hint: Add three words to AGENTS.md:7 so the unit is explicit, e.g. "… are legacy; convert one when you edit that header line, not merely when you edit the file." No other change needed — the rest of the paragraph is accurate and matches .claude/agents/registry-docs.md:20.
issues.title: "migrate when touched" does not say whether the unit of touch is the header line or the file

verdict.summary:
Round 2 resolves both round-1 findings; the diff is comment/doc-only and I found no new defect.

R1 MAJOR (incomplete sweep) — FIXED. containers/worker-model.Dockerfile:1 is now `# [SPARQ agent] REG-3 model sandbox: ...`. A tree-wide grep for the literal `[GPT-5.6]` returns ZERO matches. The surviving plain-prose `GPT-5.6` mentions (README.md:84/250/262, orchestration/routing.toml:254/268, policy/repos.toml:5/10/16/23, scripts/triage.py:186, scripts/plan-alert.py:8, scripts/worker-live.sh model_display_name table + its #97 self-test literals at 7385-7550) are the issue-#97 variant-qualified model taxonomy and were correctly left alone — genericizing them would have re-asserted the exact mislabelling #97 exists to stop.

R1 MINOR (undocumented bracket form) — FIXED via the cheaper option the prior hint recommended. AGENTS.md:6-7 now defines `[SPARQ agent]` as the source-file provenance header and declares `[OPUS-5]`/`[FABLE-5]`/`[HAIKU-…]` legacy, migrating on touch. Wording mirrors the existing .claude/agents/registry-docs.md:20 phrasing verbatim, so the two do not drift. The mixed state inside scripts/policy-resolve.py (`[SPARQ agent]` at 2, `[OPUS-5]` at 43/63/120, `[FABLE-5]` at 116) and policy/repos.toml is now a documented migration rather than silent drift.

My own round-2 checks, all clean:
- Diff is exactly the 11 files shown (`git diff master...HEAD --stat` matches): 9 one-line header swaps, 1:1 line counts, plus 3 added lines in AGENTS.md. No hidden file.
- Nothing executable is touched, so no self-test is owed and no vacuous-test question arises. Every changed line sits ahead of `FROM`, the module docstring, or `set -euo pipefail`.
- No consumer reads these strings: each header sentence occurs exactly ONCE tree-wide, so no README/runbook copy can diverge, and readme-runbook-check.py parses policy/repos.toml through tomllib (semantic, not textual) — a leading comment is inert to it.
